full_track.tags: K-Pop Indie Folk. Acoustic guitar plays a percussive, syncopated strumming pattern with frequent palm muting and percussive slaps on the strings. A clean electric bass follows the root notes of the guitar progression with a warm, rounded tone. Mid-range male vocals deliver a rhythmic, almost conversational melody in Korean. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the percussive acoustic guitar and the vocal delivery. Tempo is 92 BPM in the key of G Major.
